items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore ruled out due to shoulder injury after landing hard and being questionable with stinger/X-rays during TNF vs Lions.
items.implication: Reduced targets for Bills offense rest of TNF; monitor for Week 3.

items.text: Nico Collins hurt hamstring in Wed practice (Grade 1), DNP Thu; status in jeopardy for Week 2 vs CIN despite not serious. Missed 5 games on hammy in 2024. Ran 37/42 routes Week 1.
items.why: Hamstring strain history + practice absence; MRI confirmed Grade 1.
items.implication: High risk sit; monitor Fri practice.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson full practice, 'ready to go' after ankle; unclear snaps vs Rhamondre but timed perfectly with AJ Brown IR and soft matchups ahead (PIT/JAX/BUF etc).
items.why: Full practice + self-report ready; NE desperate for explosives post-Brown IR.
items.implication: Volatile FLEX; Stevenson still RB2 base.

items.text: Brock Bowers DNP again (knee surgery meniscus trim); yet to practice post-surgery, uncertain Week 2 vs LAC.
items.implication: High OUT risk; Mayer fringe TE1.

items.text: Ladd McConkey DNP second straight day (ribs); unlikely available Week 2 vs Raiders.
items.opportunity: Quentin Johnston targets/routes boost; Tre Harris deep.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) DNP second straight practice Thu; Ja'Kobi Lane IR (wrist). If Flowers OUT vs NO, hierarchy: Bateman, Devontez Walker, Wester, Sarratt, Moore.
items.implication: GTD or OUT risk; Bateman flex upside.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Bateman/Andrews if OUT.

items.text: Dak Prescott LOVE: Home avg 21.3 PPG last yr; WAS torched 14.5 YPC/3 TDs W1; DAL top-5 implied total (27) in high-total game.
DeVonta Smith LOVE despite tough W1: 27% tgt/13.7 aDOT/3 deep; TEN allowed 85% catch/16 YPR.
items.why: Rebound spot vs soft TEN secondary.

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE: 24% target share (tied lead), 74% snaps/21 of 24 RB touches through 3Q Week 1; Indy just allowed 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry. RB1 overall range of outcomes.
Ashton Jeanty LOVE: Utilization Score 99 (tied Bijan lead) Week 1 under Kubiak; 19% tgt share last 10; 25+ touches 3/4 recent.
Bucky Irving LOVE: Career-high 26% tgt share, +8 routes vs Gainwell, all RB RZ touches Week 1; CLE allowed 121 rush/4.8 YPC.
Justin Jefferson LOVE: 37% tgt share from Wentz Week 1; 93 yds/18 PPG career with Wentz; CHI D allowed 10+ YPT to CAR WRs.
Travis Etienne HATE: Matched Miller rushes W1 (most pts air); Kamara expected back squeezes role; NO 8.5 dog vs BAL not run-friendly.
Marvin Harrison Jr. HATE: Only 8% tgt share (5th on team) W1, zero RZ looks; SEA 3rd-fewest PPG to WRs.
